description.value: Cosy Inn Cafe is a long-standing neighbourhood diner on Dunbar Street in Vancouver serving a broad menu of Chinese dishes, all-day breakfast, burgers, and sandwiches. Regulars praise generous portions and consistent quality, and the cafe supports online ordering for quick pickup. Its central Dunbar location makes it a practical mid-ride or post-ride meal stop for cyclists in the area.
